questions: Which 5 countries gained the most life expectancy between 1990 and 2020, and what was their GDP per capita in 2020?
results.answer_sql: WITH life_exp_1990 AS (SELECT ENTITY, LIFE_EXPECTANCY FROM DATAMIND.PUBLIC.OWID_LIFE_EXPECTANCY WHERE YEAR = 1990 AND NOT CODE IS NULL AND NOT CODE LIKE 'OWID%'), life_exp_2020 AS (SELECT ENTITY, LIFE_EXPECTANCY FROM DATAMIND.PUBLIC.OWID_LIFE_EXPECTANCY WHERE YEAR = 2020 AND NOT CODE IS NULL AND NOT CODE LIKE 'OWID%'), gdp_2020 AS (SELECT ENTITY, GDP_PER_CAPITA FROM DATAMIND.PUBLIC.OWID_GDP_PER_CAPITA WHERE YEAR = 2020 AND NOT CODE IS NULL AND NOT CODE LIKE 'OWID%') SELECT le20.ENTITY, (le20.LIFE_EXPECTANCY - le90.LIFE_EXPECTANCY) AS life_expectancy_gain, gdp.GDP_PER_CAPITA FROM life_exp_2020 AS le20 JOIN life_exp_1990 AS le90 ON le20.ENTITY = le90.ENTITY JOIN gdp_2020 AS gdp ON le20.ENTITY = gdp.ENTITY ORDER BY life_expectancy_gain DESC LIMIT 5
results.truth_sql:
SELECT A.ENTITY, B.LIFE_EXPECTANCY - A.LIFE_EXPECTANCY, G.GDP_PER_CAPITA
FROM DATAMIND.PUBLIC.OWID_LIFE_EXPECTANCY A JOIN DATAMIND.PUBLIC.OWID_LIFE_EXPECTANCY B ON A.ENTITY = B.ENTITY
JOIN DATAMIND.PUBLIC.OWID_GDP_PER_CAPITA G ON G.ENTITY = A.ENTITY AND G.YEAR = 2020
WHERE A.YEAR = 1990 AND B.YEAR = 2020 AND A.CODE IS NOT NULL AND A.CODE NOT LIKE 'OWID%'
ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5
assumptions: Calculated gain as the difference between life expectancy in 2020 and 1990.
Only included entities that have data for all three requirements: life expectancy in 1990, life expectancy in 2020, and GDP per capita in 2020.
